svg.text: Collapsing the smaller copies into the larger one, onto the surface
each nested copy flies out and lands as a point on the torus surface (the smallest collapse first): collapse t z = (1 − t)·z
proved: collapse_zero / collapse_one (intact → landed), collapse_norm_le (never expands)
collapse_norm_antitone (later = more collapsed); torsion_card_dvd (small lattice → large: d² | N²)
the surface is an elliptic curve ℂ/(ℤ+ℤτ), self-similar via j: surface_is_selfsimilar
